title: Có hiệu lực trong bao nhiêu ngày?
englishTitle: How many days is it valid?
pronunciation: Co hieu luc trong bao nhieu ngay
summary: For checking the exact validity period before you buy a SIM, pass, ticket, or day-use service.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask before paying or leaving the counter, while the plan, receipt, or phone screen is still easy to check.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the plan or receipt first. Let the answer be a number of days, an expiry date, or a quick correction.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Có hiệu lực means valid or effective; trong bao nhiêu ngày asks for how many days.

breakdown.vietnamese: Có hiệu lực trong bao nhiêu ngày?
breakdown.english: How many days is it valid?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi, SIM, charger, and data-top-up cards cover the phone errands that usually follow.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at SIM shops, ticket counters, rental desks, hotel desks, and service counters before you walk away.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Validity periods can be spoken fast. A written date or marked receipt is easier to trust later.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to battery, charger, charge-here, data-top-up, or eSIM cards if the timing question turns into phone setup.
